QuestInfo.1: You have received a request from Marcel to take out #r70#k enormous mice called the #rBlack Ratz#k that live in the depths of Eos Tower. Black Ratz can be found between #b#m221023000##k and #b#m221022700##k.
QuestInfo.2: You got rid of the #bBlack Ratz#k for Marcel in Ludibrium. There's probably still something lingering outside the tower though...

0.0: Wow, great timing! I actually have something else to ask you for a little help on. A few days ago, one of the guys from us reported that Eos Tower is now full of even nastier monsters than last time, and so I thought of you as the enforcer... so can you do it instead of me??

yes.0: Yikes. I just got word that the rats that reside in Eos Tower have bred. Get back to tower and thin them out!
yes.1: Take down #r70#k of those #r#o3210205##k monsters inside Eos Tower. They're the ones that look like little mice with wind-up keys on their backs. You can find them between #b#m221023000##k and #b#m221022700##k.

no.0: Really. This task isn't that difficult, and I think you can do it. If you have any free time, then come talk to me.

1.0: Awesome! You took them all out again! Anyway, thank you for helping me out. Let me give you an item that you'll need to use for hunting as a reward.

yes.0: Thank you so much for your help, but it seems like Eos Tower is still full of nasty monsters. I have a lot to ask of you, so if you have any free time, please come talk to me.

mob.0: I don't think you did what I asked of you. Please head to Eos Tower and take out #r70#k #r#o3210205##k monsters.
